an5.53:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti, saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an5.53:1.4: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti,
an5.53:1.6: samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya,
an5.53:1.8: yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikattā Satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu,
an5.53:1.9: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu,
an5.53:1.10: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
